title: Time of Session Low
summary: How often the session's low printed within the first m minutes (default: the first hour). The denominator is every session with a resolved low time; the numerator is the ones whose first print of the low came before the cutoff. Read it with high-time: together the two distributions describe how often each extreme forms early, which is the honest core of every 'the low is in by 10:30' claim.

params.name: within
params.doc: Cutoff from the session open, in minutes.
